content.title: Pokemon Trading Card Game: Chaos Rising Elite Trainer Box | GameStop
content.text: Nightfall Over Lumiose City The bustle of metropolitan Kalos transforms into havoc as a mysterious energy surge sweeps through the streets of Lumiose City. This expansion invites you to navigate an urban landscape under siege, where the tactical defense of Mega Greninja ex must ward off the destructive turmoil of Mega Floette ex. Shop The Chaos Rising Collection The High Stakes of Mega Evolution Master the return of Mega Evolution with the high-risk, high-reward Unstable Evolution mechanic. Strategic Trainers must now weigh the power of a successful coin flip against the threat of self-inflicted damage, all while wielding the massive HP pools and devastating attacks of a new generation of Mega Pokémon ex. A Collector’s Urban Paradise With over 120 cards to discover, Chaos Rising features more than 35 Special Illustration Rares that capture the cinematic intensity of the Kalos region. From Mega Greninja ex blurring through rain-slicked streets to the somber history revealed in AZ’s Tranquility, every pack offers a chance to own a breathtaking piece of this metropolitan nightmare. A Legacy Thirty Years in the Making Celebrate Pokémon’s 30th anniversary with the First Partner Illustration Collection - Series 2, releasing as a special milestone after the Chaos Rising season. This collection honors the legacy of the Johto, Unova, and Galar starters, offering exclusive illustration rare promos that bridge thirty years of adventure with stunning new artwork. Partner Up with the Series 2 Collection
